summary: Point and click adventure escape room
description:
A point-and-click escape room!

The Legacy series continues with Legacy 2: The Ancient Curse, a classic point-and-click adventure game inspired by the timeless classics of the '90s, now updated with modern graphics and controls.

This game picks up immediately after Legacy: The Lost Pyramid, but don’t worry if you haven’t played the previous title! The game will fill you in on the background story at the start.
When your brother disappeared in the Pyramid, only one person was capable of following in his footsteps—you. Now you’ve ventured deeper into the ruins than anyone could have imagined, and you’re faced with even greater challenges. Hopefully, you will find your brother again, but are you prepared for the secrets the Pyramid holds? Can you both escape, or will there have to be a sacrifice?

This game is packed with puzzles and hidden objects. More than twice the size of the first title, it will put you to the test with logical puzzles and memory challenges. The difficulty of the puzzles varies throughout the game: some are easy and quick to solve, while others will truly challenge you. Find objects, discover hidden items, spot clues in the environment, and solve mini-games—this game has it all.

If you get stuck, don’t worry. The game includes a fantastic hint system that will nudge you in the right direction. If that’s not enough, the hints will gradually become more revealing, eventually showing the full solution. This ensures smooth, relaxing gameplay while still respecting your intelligence and puzzle-solving abilities.
At the start, you can choose to play in either Normal or Hard mode. In Hard mode, the hint system is disabled, providing a real challenge for experienced point-and-click adventure players.

To aid you, you have a camera with you, allowing you to take photos of anything you see inside the ancient Pyramid. No need to write notes or take manual screenshots using your phone or tablet!

This is a remaster of the game released a few years ago. The entire game has been rebuilt from the ground up, with improved controls and stunning graphics, thanks to a new lighting system. Some obscure puzzles from the original version have been removed or revamped to enhance the overall gaming experience.
The game is fully 3D—look around, walk around, and explore as if you were in a real place.

What are you waiting for? Adventure awaits! Play this point-and-click escape room adventure now!

Notable features:

• Hint system for when you get stuck on a puzzle
• Auto-save feature to track your progress
• An incredible number of puzzles and riddles
• Hidden objects
• In-game camera to take photos of anything you see
• A rich, engaging story
• Multiple endings
• Available in English, French, German, Spanish, and Swedish

Available for Play Pass!
